source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeMessagingResultNotificationDTOsEvidenceTest { @isTest static void rows() { Messaging.SingleEmailMessage invalid = new Messaging.SingleEmailMessage(); invalid.setToAddresses(new List<String>{'missing-body@example.test'}); List<Messaging.SendEmailResult> results = Messaging.sendEmail(new List<Messaging.SingleEmailMessage>{invalid}, false); System.assertEquals(1, results.size()); System.assertEquals(false, results[0].isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(1, results[0].getErrors().size()); Messaging.SendEmailError err = results[0].getErrors()[0]; System.assertEquals('Email body is required.', err.getMessage()); System.assertEquals(0, err.getFields().size()); System.assertEquals('REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING', err.getStatusCode()); System.assertEquals(null, err.getTargetObjectId()); Messaging.CustomNotification custom = new Messaging.CustomNotification(); custom.setNotificationTypeId('0ML000000000001AAA'); custom.setSenderId('005000000000001AAA'); custom.setTitle('Trail'); custom.setBody('Body'); custom.setTargetId('001000000000001AAA'); custom.setTargetPageRef('/lightning/r/Account/001000000000001AAA/view'); custom.send(new Set<String>{'005000000000001AAA'}); Messaging.ActionResult action = new Messaging.ActionResult.Builder().withSuccess(true).withMessage('ok').withErrorCode(Messaging.ActionError.INVALID_STATE).build(); System.assertEquals(true, action.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals('ok', action.getMessage()); System.assertEquals(Messaging.ActionError.INVALID_STATE, action.getErrorCode()); Messaging.Builder genericBuilder = new Messaging.Builder().withSuccess(true).withMessage('generic ok').withErrorCode(Messaging.ActionError.INVALID_STATE).withActionIdentifier('open').withNotificationTypeId('0ML000000000001AAA').withRecipientId('005000000000001AAA').withSenderId('005000000000002AAA').withTargetId('001000000000001AAA').withTargetPageRef('/lightning/r/Account/001000000000001AAA/view'); Object genericValue = genericBuilder.build(); Messaging.ActionResult genericAction = (Messaging.ActionResult)genericValue; System.assertEquals(true, genericAction.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals('generic ok', genericAction.getMessage()); System.assertEquals(Messaging.ActionError.INVALID_STATE, genericAction.getErrorCode()); Messaging.ActionableNotification note = new Messaging.ActionableNotification.Builder().withActionIdentifier('open').withNotificationTypeId('0ML000000000001AAA').withRecipientId('005000000000001AAA').withSenderId('005000000000002AAA').withTargetId('001000000000001AAA').withTargetPageRef('/lightning/r/Account/001000000000001AAA/view').build(); System.assertEquals('open', note.getActionIdentifier()); System.assertEquals('0ML000000000001AAA', note.getNotificationTypeId()); System.assertEquals('005000000000001AAA', note.getRecipientId()); System.assertEquals('005000000000002AAA', note.getSenderId()); System.assertEquals('001000000000001AAA', note.getTargetId()); System.assertEquals('/lightning/r/Account/001000000000001AAA/view', note.getTargetPageRef()); Map<String,Object> shortPayload = Messaging.PushNotificationPayload.apple('Alert', 'default', 1, new Map<String,Object>{'recordId' => '001000000000001AAA'}); System.assertEquals('001000000000001AAA', shortPayload.get('recordId')); Map<String,Object> shortAps = (Map<String,Object>)shortPayload.get('aps'); System.assertEquals('Alert', shortAps.get('alert')); System.assertEquals('default', shortAps.get('sound')); System.assertEquals(1, shortAps.get('badge')); Map<String,Object> longPayload = Messaging.PushNotificationPayload.apple('Body', 'OPEN', 'LOCAL_KEY', new List<String>{'one', 'two'}, 'launch.png', 'chime', 2, new Map<String,Object>{'caseId' => '500000000000001AAA'}); System.assertEquals('500000000000001AAA', longPayload.get('caseId')); Map<String,Object> longAps = (Map<String,Object>)longPayload.get('aps'); Map<String,Object> alert = (Map<String,Object>)longAps.get('alert'); System.assertEquals('Body', alert.get('body')); System.assertEquals('OPEN', alert.get('action-loc-key')); System.assertEquals('LOCAL_KEY', alert.get('loc-key')); System.assertEquals('launch.png', alert.get('launch-image')); System.assertEquals('chime', longAps.get('sound')); System.assertEquals(2, longAps.get('badge')); Messaging.PushNotification push = new Messaging.PushNotification(shortPayload); push.setPayload(longPayload); push.setTtl(60); push.send('ConnectedApp', new Set<String>{'005000000000001AAA'}); } }

@isTest private class CoreRuntimeMessagingResultNotificationDepthTest { @isTest static void rows() { Messaging.SingleEmailMessage invalid = new Messaging.SingleEmailMessage(); invalid.setToAddresses(new List<String>{'missing-body@example.test'}); List<Messaging.SendEmailResult> results = Messaging.sendEmail(new List<Messaging.SingleEmailMessage>{invalid}, false); Messaging.SendEmailResult result = results[0]; System.assertEquals(false, result.success); System.assertEquals(1, result.errors.size()); Messaging.SendEmailError err = result.errors[0]; System.assertEquals('Email body is required.', err.message); StatusCode status = err.statusCode; System.assertEquals(StatusCode.REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING, status); System.assertEquals(null, err.targetObjectId); Messaging.ActionError actionError = Messaging.ActionError.INVALID_STATE; Messaging.CustomNotification custom = new Messaging.CustomNotification(); custom.setNotificationTypeId('0ML000000000001AAA'); custom.setTitle('Trail'); custom.setBody('Body'); custom.setTargetId('001000000000001AAA'); Messaging.CustomNotification fullCustom = new Messaging.CustomNotification('0ML000000000001AAA', '005000000000001AAA', 'Trail', 'Body', '001000000000001AAA', '/lightning/r/Account/001000000000001AAA/view'); Messaging.CustomNotification clonedCustom = (Messaging.CustomNotification)custom.clone(); System.assertNotEquals(custom, clonedCustom); String customJSON = JSON.serialize(clonedCustom); System.assert(customJSON.contains('Trail')); System.assert(customJSON.contains('001000000000001AAA')); clonedCustom.send(new Set<String>{'005000000000001AAA'}); fullCustom.send(new Set<String>{'005000000000001AAA'}); Messaging.ActionResult.Builder actionBuilder = new Messaging.ActionResult.Builder(); actionBuilder.withSuccess(true).withMessage('ok').withErrorCode(actionError); Messaging.ActionResult.Builder clonedActionBuilder = (Messaging.ActionResult.Builder)actionBuilder.clone(); System.assertNotEquals(actionBuilder, clonedActionBuilder); Messaging.ActionResult clonedBuilderAction = clonedActionBuilder.build(); System.assertEquals(true, clonedBuilderAction.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals('ok', clonedBuilderAction.getMessage()); System.assertEquals(actionError, clonedBuilderAction.getErrorCode()); Messaging.ActionResult action = actionBuilder.build(); Messaging.ActionResult clonedAction = (Messaging.ActionResult)action.clone(); System.assertNotEquals(action, clonedAction); System.assertEquals(true, clonedAction.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals('ok', clonedAction.getMessage()); Messaging.ActionableNotification.Builder noteBuilder = new Messaging.ActionableNotification.Builder(); noteBuilder.withActionIdentifier('open').withNotificationTypeId('0ML000000000001AAA').withRecipientId('005000000000001AAA').withSenderId('005000000000002AAA').withTargetId('001000000000001AAA').withTargetPageRef('/lightning/r/Account/001000000000001AAA/view'); Messaging.ActionableNotification.Builder clonedNoteBuilder = (Messaging.ActionableNotification.Builder)noteBuilder.clone(); System.assertNotEquals(noteBuilder, clonedNoteBuilder); Messaging.ActionableNotification clonedBuilderNote = clonedNoteBuilder.build(); System.assertEquals('open', clonedBuilderNote.getActionIdentifier()); System.assertEquals('0ML000000000001AAA', clonedBuilderNote.getNotificationTypeId()); System.assertEquals('001000000000001AAA', clonedBuilderNote.getTargetId()); Messaging.ActionableNotification note = noteBuilder.build(); Messaging.ActionableNotification clonedNote = (Messaging.ActionableNotification)note.clone(); System.assertNotEquals(note, clonedNote); System.assertEquals('open', clonedNote.getActionIdentifier()); Messaging.PushNotificationPayload payloadDTO = new Messaging.PushNotificationPayload(); Messaging.PushNotificationPayload clonedPayloadDTO = (Messaging.PushNotificationPayload)payloadDTO.clone(); System.assertNotEquals(payloadDTO, clonedPayloadDTO); Messaging.PushNotification emptyPush = new Messaging.PushNotification(); Map<String,Object> shortPayload = Messaging.PushNotificationPayload.apple('Alert', 'default', 1, new Map<String,Object>()); Messaging.PushNotification push = new Messaging.PushNotification(shortPayload); push.setPayload(shortPayload); push.setTtl(60); Messaging.PushNotification clonedPush = (Messaging.PushNotification)push.clone(); System.assertNotEquals(push, clonedPush); String pushJSON = JSON.serialize(clonedPush); System.assert(pushJSON.contains('Alert')); System.assert(pushJSON.contains('60')); emptyPush.setPayload(shortPayload); clonedPush.send('ConnectedApp', new Set<String>{'005000000000001AAA'}); } }
